metric_definitions.accuracy: Share of test rows predicted correctly.
metric_definitions.precision: TP / (TP + FP) for the positive class (target = 1, attack traffic).
metric_definitions.recall: TP / (TP + FN) for the positive class (target = 1).
metric_definitions.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for the positive class.
metric_definitions.roc_auc: Area under the ROC curve from predicted probability of target = 1.
